overall: The AG found no violation: a notice listing a topic as "Discussion" did not need to flag a possible vote, because the vote naturally flowed from discussion of the posted topic.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board voted on a Main Street speed limit change at its August 23 meeting, though the notice said only 'discussion' would take place.
allegations.key_passage: It is reasonably foreseeable that a public body may take action and hold a vote following discussion of a topic listed on a meeting notice; the Open Meeting Law does not require that the notice separately indicate the possibility of a vote.
